combo_label: Around the House × Pottery & Ceramics × Alice in Wonderland

entries.clue: Kneading the body to drive out every air bubble
Lop the top off a courtier, as the card queen shrieks roughly once a minute
Odds and ends piling up until the spare room can take no more
Roll of wipe-clean sheeting laid down over bare boards
Endless six-o'clock gathering hosted by a hare and a hatter
Stout post at the foot or turn of a stair, anchoring the rail
Unfired work, still dry and fragile enough to crumble
Words on the cake in the little glass box under the table
Loop pulled from wet clay and stuck to the side of a mug
Person holding a home under a signed lease from its owner
